description: Frontmatter contract for FIELDNOTES blog posts.

title.description: The public title of the post.

description.description: A concise summary used in post listings and metadata.

date.description: The publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

category.description: The primary section in which the post appears.

tags.description: Optional discovery labels for the post.

draft.description: Whether the post should be excluded from publication.

featured.description: Whether the post should receive featured placement.
